What changes when
compliance is built in, not
bolted on.

Hireyoo is purpose-built with compliance at its core. Rather than bolting on compliance layers, every feature respects and automates Philippine labor law.

Deadlines and rates that
update on their own.

Contribution tables, filing requirements, tax rates, and mandatory deductions update automatically. You never miss a deadline, rate change, or regulatory update.

Payroll that understands
Philippine law.

Automatic calculations for SSS, PhilHealth, PAGIBIG, BIR withholding tax, 13th month pay, holiday premiums, night shift differentials, and more. Every peso calculated correctly.

One system, the whole
employee lifecycle.

From hiring and onboarding, through attendance and leave management, to payroll and offboarding. A single source of truth for your entire workforce.

Built for how Philippine
businesses actually run.

Support for multi-branch operations, regional compliance variations, remote teams, contractor management, and the unique challenges of growing Philippine companies.
